missions.name: Shere Khan's Raid
missions.description: Shere Khan has attacked the village! As a crawling toddler, Mowgli must creep through the jungle, ducking into caves and leaf-shadows to hide from the prowling tiger.

missions.name: Canopy Crossing
missions.description: Jump across ancient moss logs and bounce on helpful Green Toads to cross the jungle sky!

missions.name: Mystic Swamplands
missions.description: Avoid the deep muddy marsh bottom! Timely jumps onto moving vine-bridges and toxic red bouncy Toads are required.

missions.name: Ancient Jungle Ruins
missions.description: The ultimate temple trial! Use horizontal moving platforms and consecutive high-momentum Toad jumps to safely reach the ancient altar.

missions.name: Clockwork Rapids
missions.description: A sprint through rushing ruins. Reach the safety gate in 10 seconds while time-bonuses from bananas and stars keep you alive.

missions.name: Elephant Patrol Path
missions.description: March along the old elephant trail before the clock runs out! Grab fruit on the way to keep your time bank topped up.

missions.name: Kaa's Hypnotic Hollow
missions.description: A swaying cave of vines and hidden coils. Keep moving before the hypnotic mist catches up with the clock!

missions.name: Bandar-Log Temple Riddle
missions.description: Stone monkey idols guard the ruined temple gate. Only someone who truly knows Mowgli's story can answer the riddle and pass.

missions.name: Shere Khan's Scorched Trail
missions.description: The dry season jungle crackles underfoot. Stay fast and light-footed — lingering here is never safe.

missions.name: Monsoon Falls Sprint
missions.description: Rain hammers the canopy and the rivers rise fast. Cross the swinging vine bridges before the falls catch up!

missions.name: Man-Village Homecoming
missions.description: The final stretch! Race through the last ruins toward the lights of the man-village before time runs out. Mowgli's journey ends here.

fights.name: The Final Reckoning
fights.description: Years later, a grown Mowgli returns to the village with fire in hand. Shere Khan stalks in for one last duel before the watching villagers. End it.

quizzes.title: The Bandar-Log Riddle Gate
quizzes.intro: Ancient stone monkeys block the path forward. They will only move aside for someone who truly knows Mowgli's tale — answer all questions correctly to pass!

cs.title: Hádanková Brána Bandar-Logů
cs.intro: Starobylé kamenné opice blokují cestu. Uhnou jen tomu, kdo skutečně zná příběh Mauglího — odpověz správně na všechny otázky, abys mohl projít!

questionPool.question: Who is the wise black panther who finds baby Mowgli and brings him to the wolf pack?

cs.question: Kdo je mudrc, černý panter, který najde malého Mauglího a přivede ho k smečce vlků?

questionPool.question: Which laid-back bear teaches Mowgli about "The Bare Necessities"?

cs.question: Který pohodový medvěd učí Mauglího o tom, co je v životě opravdu potřeba?

questionPool.question: Which tiger wants to hunt Mowgli because he fears and hates Man?

cs.question: Který tygr chce Mauglího ulovit, protože se bojí a nenávidí lidi?
